say:4:1122413003:1.text: Ha! It actually began ages ago, the first day this camp was being built.
say:4:1122413003:1.source_cn: 哈，瞧瞧我瞒得多好！从建立基地的第一天，这堂课就开始了。

say:5:1122413004:1.text: This last lesson was all about trust.

say:7:1122413005:1.text: Like how you didn't tell <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Wildclaw about the explosives.

say:8:1122413006:1.text: Well, yeah, but there's more to it than that.

say:10:1122413007:1.text: Splitting the reward money after a job is also a sign of your trust.
say:10:1122413007:1.source_cn: 从你们完成委托后拿到的酬金里抽成，也是对你们信任的考验。

say:11:1122413008:1.text: Bounty hunters value money. There's no better way to test someone's trust than with money.
say:11:1122413008:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人看重钱财，用钱来考验信任，最合适不过了！

say:12:1122413009:1.text: Maulers like Grayhorn always think that I'm somehow cheating them out of their coin, no matter how much I explain what I'm doing.
say:12:1122413009:1.source_cn: 像老憨那样的人，他们总是认为抽成的钱被我独吞了，不管我...

say:13:1122413010:1.text: Thankfully, you and Wildclaw didn't let me down.

say:16:1122413014:1.text: So, I just wanted to thank you for believing me.

say:20:1122413018:1.text: You're already a full-blown bounty hunter!

say:22:1122413015:1.text: Ha! It looks like you've been spending too much time with us. You even sound like a Mauler.
say:22:1122413015:1.source_cn: 呵。感觉你和我们在一起待久了，说话也变得很不客气啊。

choice:14:0:1.text: I always try to trust people.

say:23:1122413012:1.text: You're not one of those goat-kissing bounty hunters who love money more than their lives. That's why I brought you in.
